Shared immutable context: stable subsets/aliases, private subclass defaults, symmetric glycine, content-derived identities and custom reflected grid origins. Generic bonded parameter scaling and ligand charge scaling change values/gradients; incomplete charge/type parameters reject.

Named connection ports and shared sparse capped graph preparation preserve branches/cycles. Dense compatibility layout remains. Native LJ/LK, electrostatics and fused nonbonded permit full int32 connection atom indices after a shared two-bond-exclusion invariant exposed byte truncation; at most12 connection ports remain supported. Other term boundaries remain explicit.

Shared atom topology and four geometric formulas with framework-native callbacks. Independent analytic coordinate/parameter gradients and mixed ligand/protein identity pass Torch CPU and JAX CPU/CUDA. Pose selection, parameter Hessians and torsion JVP/vmap pass JAX CPU. Legacy coordinate restraints retained; more than two block runs reject explicitly; packing absent.
Mixed ligand/HYP/GLY batches: native gen/cart coordinate gradients, independent poses and vmap tested CPU/CUDA; packing/topology mutation APIs absent.

Ligand, connected beta-amino acid and D-peptide objectives decrease with exact frozen-atom and unchanged-input invariants in Torch CPU and JAX CPU/CUDA. These objectives cover native cartbonded/nonbonded plus generic bonded or Dunbrack; complete noncanonical objective remains absent.

Shared residue-choice preparation: terminal variants, L/D chirality policy, AIB, disulfide identity, ligands and padding pass Torch/JAX CPU invariants. JAX PackerPalette exposes choices and repacking masks. PackerTask, rotamer generation, pack_rotamers and mutation execution remain absent.

FoldForest shares chemical spanning, polymer cycles and chain-gap policy with Torch; molecular components and explicit chain metadata tested. Prepared atom forests share validated indices and native inverse/forward scans. Bound maps accept six movable DOF columns with fixed reference rotations and support first reverse derivatives, jit and vmap. Inverse-coordinate derivatives, forward-mode AD, higher derivatives, automatic pose-to-atom-forest preparation, MoveMap and molecular internal-coordinate minimization remain absent. Molecular runtime oracles use Torch atom-forest metadata.
JAX run_cart_relax is a no-pack ramp, not FastRelax.
No public JAX fragment decomposition/recombination.

Canonical PDB/Biotite loading consumes the complete shared canonical metadata and rejects unknown atom names. Explicit ResidueBlock input supports arbitrary prepared residue identities and parameter contexts. General CIF/ligand preparation/selection adapters remain absent.

Shared native gen/cart/backbone/NA/metal/Dunbrack/fused nonbonded first-order JVP, reverse Jacobian and sequential vmap tested CPU/CUDA. Independent LJ/LK and electrostatics now consume common native kernels; CPU/CUDA transformations and empty batches pass. Higher coordinate derivatives remain absent for native terms.
